entry.title: TR-MPC 1.1.0
entry.summary: Modular 16-slot drum kit, any voice of 6W6, 8W8, CW-78 and 9W9 per slot, with one shared reverb, delay and master chain. Built on athousanddetails' Schwung drum machines. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force.

entry.title: TR-MPC 1.0.2
entry.summary: Fixes the slot panels not reskinning when you pick a different voice type (6W6, 8W8, CW-78, 9W9): the voice menu now asks MPC to refresh the screen. No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: TR-MPC 1.0.1
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.
